description:
The moment you flash an instant automatic grin at someone the second you make eye contact, you haven't signaled warmth.

That's the heart of How to Talk to Anyone by Leil Lowndes — and it's not the story you remember.

A deep analysis of "How to Talk to Anyone" by Leil Lowndes — the characters, the turning points, the themes, and the one argument the book quietly proves. We cover what happens, what it means, and the reading most people miss, and we take on the book's hardest criticism head-on.

Best for readers studying How to Talk to Anyone for class or a book club, and anyone who wants the real takeaway — spoilers included.
